items.t: What Does Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Appeal Loss Mean For Investors?
items.sum: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) lost an appeal in Louisiana, where an appellate court upheld a multimillion dollar talc verdict. The decision affirmed a jury finding that asbestos in Johnson & Johnson talc products was linked to mesothelioma and a plaintiff's death. The appellate panel also confirmed a substantial increase in damages, expanding Johnson & Johnson's financial exposure in this talc case
